title: Havenline buy and activation plots: direct source evidence
scope: Read-only visual source map for seven buy/work turnaround concepts and two use-state plates within the frozen26-sheet plot contract. No runtime changes or economy approval.
authority: Actual supplied recording pixels take priority over older raised-pad generators, kit metadata and abstract presentation fixtures.

source_videos.audio: present; not audited for this visual source task

inspection.timing_boundary: Overview2fps sheets use nominal half-second bins. Exact detail sheets use individually requested0.1second seeks. Recording edits and speed changes prevent inferring game action durations.

shared_geometry.shape: Small flat rounded-square ground marker; appears diamond-shaped in oblique view. No raised deck thickness, pedestal, posts or upright billboard evidenced.
shared_geometry.idle_fill: Warm dark brown in camp examples; gray on snow for initial material-funded construction.
shared_geometry.boundary: Exactly four separated rounded corner brackets, white when idle. Not a continuous storage rim.
shared_geometry.graphics: White action glyph and cost field lie in the ground plane and share its projection. A green banknote or wood pictogram can precede the price; B cash pads instead show white dollar symbol.
shared_geometry.active_payment: Outer corner brackets become bright green. A bright green fill advances across the interior while contribution occurs.
shared_geometry.work_zone_difference: An outlined elongated rounded rectangle with dash segments and unfilled ground inside; white idle, green active. It has no action glyph or price.
